# Kelly Code

> Kelly Code is a cultural and conceptual research project examining
> visual identity as an organizing structure and its transformation
> into broader cultural systems.

## Primary Website

https://kellycode.us/

## Author

Nicholas Van-Orton

https://nvo987.us/

## Organization

NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

https://nvo987.fr/

## Core Subject

The Kelly Code framework studies the evolution of identity through
five analytical levels:

1. Kelly Code V1 — Portability
2. Kelly Code V2 — Emergent Meaning
3. Kelly Code V3 — Cultural Stabilization
4. Kelly Code V4 — Autonomy
5. Kelly Code V5 — The Era as Identity Structure

## Research Themes

- visual identity
- visual culture
- cultural systems
- art history
- contemporary culture
- recognizability
- visual relationships
- cultural stabilization
- controlled visibility
- curated presence
- cultural reference points
- autonomy
- systemic identity
